meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装一个本地监控面板，展示 agent 分组、会话、频道、用户、token 用量、上下文窗口和实时日志；并装一个推送器，每 60 秒发 JSON 快照、每 2 秒推日志。
howto.when: 当你给 NanoClaw 加监控面板时触发，执行 /add-dashboard，按步骤装包、拷贝推送器、接线 index.ts、配置环境变量并重启服务。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 装上监控面板
say.note: 会安装 npm 包、拷贝推送器并接线 index.ts

say.text: 按 add-dashboard 的步骤接线并重启服务
say.note: 改完会先构建、再跑测试、然后重启

say.text: 把监控面板卸掉，还原这几处改动
say.note: 删除推送器文件、卸载包并移除环境变量

howto.what_en: Installs a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw showing agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows and live logs, plus a pusher that posts JSON snapshots every 60s and streams logs every 2s.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, by running /add-dashboard.

say_en.text: Add the monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Installs the npm package, copies the pusher, wires index.ts

say_en.text: Wire it up and restart the service
say_en.note: Builds first, runs the tests, then restarts

say_en.text: Remove the dashboard and undo the changes
say_en.note: Deletes pusher files, uninstalls the package, clears env vars
